_about: Hand-maintained fund facts the price sources do not publish. Keys are NAVView fund ids. cat: mm money market, fi fixed income, bal balanced, eq equity/ETF. fee = annual management fee %, min = minimum first investment (fund currency), liq = time to get your money. dpu = regular payout per unit per month (added to returns). yld = priced at 1.00, return is the published yield. proxy = no own NAV; uses another fund's yield. inc = launch price for since-launch return.
